questions.q: What is the next number in the sequence 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, …?
questions.explanation: These are square numbers: 1², 2², 3², 4², 5², so the next is 6² = 36.

questions.q: What is the sum of the first 5 odd numbers (1 + 3 + 5 + 7 + 9)?
questions.explanation: The sum of the first n odd numbers is n², so 5² = 25.

questions.q: The triangular numbers are 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, … What comes next?
In the sequence 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, … each number is the sum of the two before it. What is the next number?
The sum of two consecutive triangular numbers (like 3 + 6) is always a ____.
What is the next term in 2, 4, 8, 16, …?
questions.explanation: Each term is double the previous term, so 16 × 2 = 32.
